shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: These shortcuts work anywhere in the launcher.

welcome.title: Shape your Voxelight space
welcome.body: Choose your language, theme, and live 3D world style. Changes preview immediately behind this card.

account.title: Player identity
account.body: Add an offline player now to jump in quickly, or sign in with Microsoft or Authlib anytime on Players.
account.onlineHint: You can sign in with Microsoft or third-party Authlib servers anytime from the Players page.

environment.title: Runtime & downloads
environment.body: Choose your preferred download source and inspect Java and automatic memory readiness.
environment.javaNone: No local Java detected yet — Voxelight can prepare the matching official runtime automatically.
environment.memorySummary: {{total}} GiB RAM detected · automatic recommendation: {{recommended}} MB.
environment.memoryAuto: Automatic memory allocation is active and adapts to your system RAM.
environment.proxyDirect: Following system proxy (no proxy active; direct connection).

ready.title: Everything is ready
ready.body: Here is where everything lives in Voxelight. You can reopen this welcome setup anytime from F1.

notifications.instance.required: Choose or create an instance first.
notifications.game.stopRequested: Stop requested. The process is still exiting.
notifications.game.notRunning: No running game matches the current selection.
notifications.versions.unavailable: Version list unavailable. Check your connection and retry.

errors.proxy.invalidScheme: Choose http:// or https:// for the launcher proxy.
errors.proxy.invalidHost: Enter a hostname, IPv4 address or bracketed IPv6 address, without a scheme or path.
errors.proxy.invalidPort: Enter a proxy port between 1 and 65535.
errors.proxy.invalidCredentials: Proxy credentials could not be saved or read. Check the username and password or enter them again.
errors.proxy.tlsInheritance: Java can only inherit an HTTP proxy. Use an http:// proxy, Follow system, or Off.
errors.proxy.authentication: The proxy requires valid credentials. Save them and try again.
errors.proxy.connection: Could not connect through this proxy. Check the host and port.
errors.proxy.tls: TLS verification failed. Check that the proxy protocol and certificates are correct.
errors.proxy.saveEndpointFirst: Save the proxy address before changing credentials.
errors.auth.sessionChanged: This account was removed or signed in again. Select the current account and retry.
errors.resource.loaderRequired: This target needs a mod loader. Choose a compatible instance or create one.
errors.resource.noCompatibleVersion: This project has no resource version for that game version and loader. Choose another instance.
errors.resource.versionMissing: Install Minecraft or create a compatible instance first.
errors.resource.installAfterCreate: The instance was created, but the resource installation failed. Retry installing the resource.
errors.resource.sourceUnsupported: Automatic target selection is not supported for this source yet. Create a compatible instance first.
errors.resource.loaderUnavailable: No loader versions are available for this game version. Choose another game version.
errors.resource.manifestUnavailable: Unable to load the Minecraft version list. Check your connection and try again.
errors.version.loaderReinstall: The version profile for {{id}} is damaged. Reinstall the same game version and loader in the Launcher. Your worlds and mods are not replaced.
errors.version.profileConflict: Voxelight kept the existing profile for {{id}} because it could not verify its source. Back up its JSON under versions first, then move that JSON aside before reinstalling the original version or loader.
errors.instance.running: This instance is already running. Do not launch it twice.
errors.install.gameRunning: A game from the same game directory is running. Exit the game before installing a version or loader.
errors.instance.notFound: The instance no longer exists. Refresh the library.
errors.instance.restorePending: This instance has an unfinished backup restore or modpack update. Recover it from the instance's backups before launching or changing it.
errors.backup.notFound: No matching instance backup was found.
errors.backup.invalid: The backup manifest is invalid and cannot be used.
errors.backup.path: The backup path is invalid. Choose another location.
errors.resource.pathUnsafe: The resource path is unsafe. Choose another path.
errors.resource.unavailable: The resource directory cannot be read. Check access permissions.
errors.datapack.invalid: Data packs must be valid .zip archives containing pack.mcmeta.
errors.datapack.exists: A data pack with the same name already exists; no files were overwritten.
errors.datapack.notFound: The selected data pack could not be found.
errors.auth.serviceKeyMissing: Save your own CurseForge API key in Settings first.
errors.game.notRunning: No running game matches the current selection.
errors.game.stopBusy: A stop request for this game is already in progress.
errors.game.stopFailed: Voxelight could not confirm that the game stopped. Check the game window before starting another session.
errors.desktop.required: Use the desktop app for this action.
errors.renderer.unavailable: 3D preview is unavailable. Check your graphics driver and hardware acceleration.
errors.skin.loadFailed: The skin could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.cape.loadFailed: The cape could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.resource.recoveryRequired: A resource transaction was interrupted. Open update history to recover it before continuing.
errors.resource.recoveryConflict: The resource copies could not be verified. No files were overwritten. Keep the existing copies and check the transaction history.
errors.resource.recoveryRunning: Stop the game using this directory before recovering the resource transaction.
errors.resource.recoveryIncomplete: Recovery did not finish. Resources may have been moved to the transaction backup. Close programs using them and retry from history.
errors.resource.recoveryNotNeeded: This transaction does not need recovery. Refresh the update history.
errors.backup.restoreRecoveryRequired: The backup restore did not finish. Keep the listed directories and use the recovery action to verify the copies again.
errors.backup.restoreRolledBack: The backup restore could not finish. The original directory was restored.
errors.backup.restoreRecoveryMissing: No backup restore needs recovery. Refresh the backup list.
errors.storage.stateChanged: Another program changed this profile. Close and reopen the launcher before saving again.
errors.storage.pathAuthorizationRequired: Choose or approve this exact path in the native dialog before continuing.
errors.storage.folderUnavailable: The launcher could not open this registered directory.
errors.instance.exportPreviewChanged: Files changed after you reviewed them. Review the updated list before exporting.
errors.modpack.unmanaged: This instance is not a modpack the launcher installed online, so it cannot be updated.
errors.modpack.planChanged: Files changed after the plan was shown. The plan was made again; review it before applying.
errors.modpack.notNewer: The selected version is not newer than the installed one. Updates never downgrade.
errors.modpack.versionMismatch: The selected version does not belong to this modpack.
errors.modpack.dependencyDrift: The instance's Minecraft version or loader no longer matches the modpack's record, so no update plan can be made.
errors.modpack.conflictChoiceInvalid: A conflict choice names a file outside the plan.
errors.modpack.stageMismatch: The updated copy did not match the plan, so the update stopped. The instance was not changed.
errors.modpack.notMrpack: The selected version is not a standard .mrpack file.
errors.modpack.manualDownload: These files' authors do not allow other apps to download them, so the launcher stopped and changed nothing. Download them from their pages: {{files}}
errors.modpack.manualDownloadRequired: The update needs files their authors do not allow the launcher to download. Put them in place first; the instance was not changed.
errors.modpack.packNotDownloadable: CurseForge does not let the launcher download this version of the modpack, so the instance cannot be updated to it online. The instance was not changed; you can download the version from the modpack's page and import it as a new instance.
errors.modpack.manifestMissing: The modpack lists a file or project that CurseForge no longer has, so it cannot be installed or updated. Nothing was changed.
errors.modpack.sharedRoot: An instance in the shared game folder or the launcher folder cannot be updated in place.
errors.modpack.platformUnavailable: The modpack platform could not be reached or refused the request. Check your network and try again; for CurseForge, check your own API key and its distribution permission.
errors.update.gameRunning: A game is running. Exit it before installing the launcher update.
errors.update.serverRunning: A managed server is running. Stop it before installing the launcher update.
errors.update.tasksRunning: Downloads or installs are still running. Wait for them to finish before installing the launcher update.
errors.update.downloading: The launcher update is still downloading.
errors.update.notStaged: The update is not downloaded yet. Download it first.
errors.update.handOffFailed: The update could not be handed to the installer. Nothing was changed; try again.
errors.update.otherInstance: Another launcher window (another profile) is running from this folder. Close it before installing the update.
errors.update.otherInstanceUnknown: The launcher could not confirm that no other launcher is running, so the update was not installed.
errors.update.checkFailed: Could not check for updates. Try again or choose another update source.
errors.update.rateLimited: GitHub's request limit was reached and fallback update information is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.update.timedOut: The update check timed out. Try again or choose another update source.
errors.update.downloadFailed: The installer could not be downloaded or verified. Try again or download it from the release page.
errors.update.sourceChanged: The update source changed. Check for updates again.
errors.update.notOffered: There is no update to download. Check for updates first.
errors.update.sourceInvalid: The update source is not valid.
errors.assistant.apiKeyRequired: Save your own AI API key in Settings → Lumen & MCP first.
errors.assistant.modelRequired: Enter a model name in Settings → Lumen & MCP first.
errors.assistant.invalidBaseUrl: The Lumen API base URL must use HTTPS, or loopback HTTP (127.0.0.1 / localhost).
errors.assistant.providerError: The configured AI service returned an error.

assistant.title: Lumen
assistant.description: Voxelight's built-in assistant for diagnosing crashes, managing instances, mods, worlds, downloads, and servers with your own AI API key.
assistant.emptyReady: Ask Lumen about your launcher setup, or pick a starter prompt below.
assistant.emptyUnconfigured: Configure a provider, model, and API key (or a local loopback endpoint) in Settings → Lumen & MCP to enable Lumen.

prompts.instances: Summarize my instances and installed versions.
prompts.resources: Check my memory setup and any recent download tasks.
prompts.servers: List my running games and managed servers.

assistant.approvalDescription: Controlled mode requires your confirmation before Lumen modifies launcher state.
assistant.inputPlaceholder: Ask Lumen about instances, crash logs, mods, downloads, or servers… (Enter to send)
assistant.inputUnconfiguredPlaceholder: Configure a model and API key in Settings → Lumen & MCP first…

wake.crashReason: Lumen woke automatically: {{target}} exited abnormally (exit code {{code}}).
wake.crashPrompt: {{target}} just exited abnormally with exit code {{code}}. Please diagnose the crash logs and recent errors, explain the likely root cause, and suggest the safest fix.
wake.logReason: Analyzing logs and crash diagnostics for {{target}}.
wake.logPrompt: Please inspect the crash diagnosis and recent error logs for {{target}}, summarize the cause, and recommend next steps.
wake.downloadsPrompt: I have {{count}} failed download task(s). Please inspect my download tasks and download source settings, explain why they failed, and suggest whether to retry or switch source.
wake.networkPrompt: My network environment check reported {{natType}} / restricted direct-connect reachability. Please run or review my network check and suggest practical options for hosting or joining Minecraft multiplayer.

reason.unavailable: The primary profile could not be accessed.
reason.corrupt: The primary profile could not be read or is damaged.
reason.newerSchema: The primary profile comes from a newer version of Voxelight.

storage.primaryRetained: The primary state file is still at: {{path}}
storage.recoveryHelp: Changes in this window are saved to the fallback profile. Fix the primary directory or upgrade the launcher, then close and reopen it.

drop.title: Drop files to import
drop.hintGeneral: Drop a .mrpack modpack here, mods inside an instance's Content tab, or a .png skin on Players.
drop.hintModpack: Drop a .mrpack or CurseForge .zip modpack to import as a new instance.
drop.hintInstanceContent: Drop .jar mods or .zip resource and shader packs to import into this instance.
drop.hintSkin: Drop a .png skin to preview it in 3D or upload it to a Microsoft account.
drop.openInstanceForMods: Open an instance's Content tab to drop .jar mods or .zip packs.
drop.openAccountsForSkins: Open the Players page to drop a .png skin.
drop.unsupported: Only .jar mods, .mrpack/.zip modpacks or packs, and .png skins can be dropped here.

external.openFailed: The system could not open this link. Copy the address to open it in your browser.
external.copyFailed: Clipboard access is unavailable. Select and copy the address manually.
